sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Remote Desktop Access and Unattended Machine Telemetry Software

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Panama (Registro Público de Panamá / Public Registry of Panama)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Panamanian Civil Code tradition) with a hybrid corporate-law overlay modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law via Law 32 of 1927; unitary national system with no sub-federal tax distinction; no Sharia application
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (2011, with Investment Chapter including ISDS protections)
Panama–United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (1986, continued in force)
Panama–Republic of Korea Double Taxation Agreement (2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (Panama AML/CFT framework, as amended by Ley 70 de 2019); Executive Decree No. 129 de 2020 establishing the UBO electronic filing regime before the Dirección Nacional de Personas Jurídicas (DNPJ); Ley 32 de 1927 (Sociedad Anónima statute); DNPJ implementing resolutions; Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SIB) AML guidance; Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) national list regulations; FATF Recommendation 24 transposed.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of the passport or national identity document of each ultimate beneficial owner, director, and corporate officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the country of origin / National Civil Registry or Passport Authority of the UBO's nationality

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) appointing the Panamanian Resident Agent and founding counsel, including evidence of the grantor's legal capacity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of Panama or, if executed abroad, a foreign notary with apostille certification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO sworn declaration (Declaración Jurada de Beneficiario Final) executed before a Panamanian notary for filing with the DNPJ
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notaría del Circuito de Panamá (Panamanian Circuit Notary)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (domestic Panamanian notarial seal; no foreign legalization required for domestically executed instruments)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified corporate charter, register extract, and certificate of good standing for any intermediate legal-entity shareholder in the UBO chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Companies Registry of the entity shareholder's jurisdiction of formation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, attorneys-in-fact, and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI List, Interpol notices, and the Panamanian national lists issued by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) and SIB; enhanced due diligence (EDD) is statutorily required for any Politically Exposed Person under Law 23/2015 Articles 22-24; the Resident Agent must retain an updated compliance file with source-of-funds evidence and a documented PEP-risk rating; for ISIC 6201 software subscription activity, the standard risk tier is Low, yet a clean sanctions and adverse-media result is a precondition for bank and payment-rail onboarding with Stripe and Paddle.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Sistema de Reserva de Nombre y Consulta de Denominaciones (Public Registry of Panama online name reservation and search portal, www.registropublico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be submitted in Latin script; Spanish and any Latin-alphabet language are accepted; names not expressed in Spanish should be accompanied by a Spanish transliteration or descriptive equivalent to avoid Registrar rejection; the mandatory legal suffix is 'Sociedad Anónima' or the abbreviation 'S.A.'; non-Latin script strings (e.g., CJK, Cyrillic) must be romanized; the commercial descriptor 'Remote Screen Share IoT' must be rendered in identifiable Latin tokens for reservation and registered-object purposes.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon an official refusal (denegatoria) issued by the Registro Público, the initiating attorney or Resident Agent may (i) file a written reconsideration request (recurso de reconsideración) with the General Directorate of the Registro Público within three business days of notification; (ii) immediately file a new reservation using a materially distinct denomination; or (iii) pursue a final judicial appeal (demanda contencioso-administrativa) before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso Administrativo of the Corte Suprema de Justicia within two months of the definitive administrative decision, with the possibility of requesting interim suspension of the rejection while the appeal is pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for ISIC 6201 (remote desktop access and unattended telemetry software) because the activity is not licensed, financial, or concession-based; the Sociedad Anónima must nonetheless maintain a registered Panama address at the Resident Agent's office and file a domicile address in the Registro Público and DGI (RUC) records; a virtual-office arrangement is structurally valid but presents moderate third-party onboarding friction for banking and Stripe/Paddle payment rails, as territorial-source rules and FATCA/CRS derivation require documented management and operational substance; recommended structure: virtual office plus a contractual support-services and local-compliance mailbox arrangement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: unannounced physical on-site inspection probability is quantified at approximately 5% per annum for a non-licensed ISIC 6201 entity; unannounced inspections primarily target licensed sectors (banking, insurance, gaming, mining, telecom) and regulated agents; DNPJ and DGI supervision for software companies is predominantly documentary and desk-based through the Resident Agent.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Public Registry name reservation and denomination clearance fee (per name candidate)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Public Registry inscription and registration of the Sociedad Anónima with authorized capital of USD 10,000
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff graduated by declared capital; minimum statutory authorized capital benchmark is USD 10,000

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Resident Agent (Agente Residente) professional services — year 1 (statutory requirement under Law 32 of 1927)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Resident Agent law firm in Panama
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of USD 250–350 per annum

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificado de Persona Jurídica of the S.A. for bank, Stripe, and Paddle verification
Hague Apostille certification of UBO passport, power of attorney, and corporate existence documents (two to three instruments)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Dirección de Legalizaciones (Apostille Office)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of USD 20 per apostille instrument

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Stage-1 pre-incorporation KYC/AML dossier, UBO piercing analysis, PEP/OFAC/UN sanctions screening, and legal due diligence review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External Panama corporate counsel / licensed advocacy firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed-fee basis for a low-risk non-licensed software holding entity

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades (Panama General Law on Stock Corporations), Law No. 32 of 26 February 1927, as amended by Law No. 5 of 2013 and Decree-Law No. 4 of 2015; applicable principal sections: Articles 8, 10, 12, 17, 25, 35, 54, and 57.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Public Registry of Panama (Registro Público de Panamá) – Mercantile Section.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) containing the Pacto Social y Estatutos, authorized by a Panama-licensed Notary Public and subsequently inscribed in the Public Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement. The corporation must issue at least one share; shares may have par or no par value. Non-resident shareholders may hold 100% of the issued shares.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the Company’s incorporation as a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima is ratified, and the shares subscribed in the Public Deed of Incorporation are hereby issued and allotted. RESOLVED FURTHER: that the registered office of the Company is fixed at the address stated in the corporate charter in Panama City, Republic of Panama, and the designated Resident Agent is approved. RESOLVED FURTHER: that the following officers are elected: President, Treasurer, and Secretary, together with the corresponding vice-presidents, each to serve until successors are appointed. RESOLVED FURTHER: that the said officers are authorized to execute all filings, open financial accounts, and retain professional advisors to complete the Company’s registration and licensing. RESOLVED FINALLY: that this consent is the Board of Directors’ act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability and Pre-Inscription Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section (name reservation and no-similarity check).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written corporate name availability request to the Public Registry, either through the online platform or at the Mercantile Section window, for verification that the proposed name is not identical or confusingly similar to any registered company. Upon confirmation, retain the name reservation for use in the drafting of the incorporation deed.
required_dossiers: Name availability request letter
Proposed corporate name (first, second, and third alternatives)
Passport copy of the subscriber or incorporator
Resident agent acceptance letter if already appointed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry rejects the proposed name due to conflict, select the alternative name and file a revised name availability request without additional public registration penalties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarial Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panama Notary Public (Notaría Pública del Circuito de Panamá).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the finalized Pacto Social y Estatutos to the chosen notary together with the name reservation certificate and the appointing documentation for the Resident Agent. The incorporator or his/her attorney-in-fact must appear before the notary to execute the Escritura Pública de Constitución. The notary will prepare the protocol and issue the first certified testimonio for registration.
required_dossiers: Final draft of Articles of Incorporation (Pacto Social y Estatutos)
Name reservation certificate
Passport or power-of-attorney documentation for signatories
Resident Agent acceptance and consent letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary rejects or suspends execution because of defective authority or missing identification, correct the power of attorney or supply the required identification and reschedule notarial execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Public Registry Filing and Corporate Inscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section (Sección del Registro Mercantil).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the first certified notarial testimonio of the Escritura Pública de Constitución to the Public Registry for filing. Pay the applicable registration fees and await inscription of the company in the Mercantile Register. Once inscribed, the Registry will assign a Ficha (corporate electronic file) and issue a certificate of registration evidencing the legal existence of the Sociedad Anónima.
required_dossiers: First certified copy (testimonio) of the Public Deed
Proof of payment of Registry inscription fees
Completed Registry cover sheet or request form
List of directors, officers, and Resident Agent as stated in the Deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a preventiva (observation or queried requirement), correct the specific deficiency in the deed or supporting documents and resubmit the file within the statutory response period; the inscription follows upon clearance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining the Tax Identification Number (RUC) at the Tax Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas – Taxpayer Registration Unit.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the company registration application with the DGI using the official RUC form and attach the Public Registry inscription certificate, proof of registered address, and identification of the legal representative. Upon successful verification, the DGI will issue the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) and assign the company’s tax identification number, together with its initial tax obligations profile.
required_dossiers: Public Registry certificate of inscription (Ficha or certification)
Certified copy of the registered Public Deed
Passport copies of the legal representative and Resident Agent
RUC application form (Formulario de Registro de Contribuyente)
Proof of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI returns the application for missing documentation, correct the file by supplying the required attachments through the Sede Electrónica portal or in-person window and resubmit for reconsideration within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Business Operation Notice, Fire Safety, and Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipality of Panama (Alcaldía de Panamá) – Dirección de Comercio e Industria; Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; Municipal Engineering Department.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Aviso de Operación (Business Operation Notice) with the Municipality of Panama, attaching the RUC certificate and proof of registered office, to formalize the right to carry out commercial/office activities. Arrange for a fire safety inspection of the premises and obtain the corresponding fire safety certificate. If the software operation uses a dedicated office, secure the building occupancy/structural load clearance from the municipal engineering office. No industrial operating license or environmental permit is required for remote screen-sharing and IoT telemetry software services.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate
Registered Public Deed of Incorporation
Lease agreement or title deed for the registered office
Completed Aviso de Operación municipal form
Fire safety inspection certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos
Building occupancy or structural load certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If municipal authorities issue observations, cure by submitting the missing fire or occupancy certificates, correcting any building-use code mismatch, and paying any applicable municipal reactivation or correction fees.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board is triggered for this office-based remote software activity. General commercial oversight is exercised by the Ministry of Commerce and Industries (Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias – MICI) and the Municipality of Panama through its Commerce and Industry Directorate.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Business Operation Notice (Aviso de Operación) – administrative endorsement only; no sectoral statutory operating license is required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment of Panama (Ministerio de Ambiente – MiAMBIENTE).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Category III (Registration / minor activity) for an office-based remote support and telemetry software service; no Full EIA Report required because there is no industrial production facility.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater, VOC, or dust discharge thresholds apply. General office solid waste must be disposed of through municipal collection; any electronic waste generated by IoT telemetry or server hardware must be handled by MiAMBIENTE-authorized recyclers or waste management operators in accordance with Panama’s e-waste regulatory framework.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá for the premises; municipal building occupancy and structural load clearance from the Dirección de Ingeniería Municipal; registration of workplace health and safety standards with the Comisión Nacional de Seguridad y Salud Ocupacional; and, where employees are hired, employer enrollment with the Caja de Seguro Social.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); official portal: https://www.dgi.gob.pa with the Sede Electrónica de la DGI (https://sede.dgi.gob.pa) for filings, e-invoicing, and RUC administration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Panamanian Sociedad Anónima obtains its statutory Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) as follows: (1) file Articles of Incorporation before a notary and inscribe the company with the Registro Público de Panamá; (2) obtain the Aviso de Operación (business license) from the Municipal Treasury of the operating district; (3) file the DGI registration form (formulario de inscripción) together with the public deed certificate, registered agent confirmation, and passport copy of the legal representative at the competent DGI regional office; (4) receive the RUC certificate, which automatically includes the ITBMS (VAT) registration where taxable activities are declared. Processing typically takes 3 to 10 business days; a provisional RUC can be issued immediately for customs and invoicing purposes pending final verifications.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope: the Panamanian S.A. is an entity-level taxpayer subject to 25% corporate income tax solely on Panamanian-source income; foreign-source income remains exempt under Panama's strict territorial tax system. There is no pass-through classification for a Sociedad Anónima; the entity is always the taxable person for domestic-source revenue.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not provide a check-the-box or hybrid mismatch pass-through election. Available statutory elections and regimes include: (a) SEM (Multinational Headquarters) license under Law 41 of 2007, electable to obtain a 5% effective income tax rate on qualifying services; (b) GKE (Knowledge Economy) regime under Law 41 of 2021 for qualifying software/technology services with reduced income tax treatment; (c) the simplified monthly turnover regime under Law 66 of 2017 for enterprises with annual gross income up to PAB 36,000; (d) cash or accrual accounting election for small taxpayers; (e) the foreign-source income exclusion is automatic under territorial principles and requires no election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) — the Panamanian VAT-equivalent; additionally the Impuesto Selectivo al Consumo applies to specific goods and the municipal business license tax is separate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No quantitative turnover threshold: any person engaging in taxable economic activity in Panama is required to register for ITBMS. For the simplified monthly regime, eligibility threshold: annual gross income up to PAB 36,000 (Law 66/2017); taxpayers above this threshold must file periodic ITBMS returns under the general regime.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica) for all ITBMS-registered taxpayers, implemented through Law 41 of 2019 and favorable DGI resolutions. Invoices must be issued as XML electronic documents with a QR code, generated through the DGI Sede Electrónica platform or certified PSA (Proveedor de Servicios de Autorización), and transmitted in real time or near real time for DGI fiscal validation and digital stamping before delivery to the purchaser.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: ITBMS at 0% applies to goods physically exported from Panama when customs export formalities are completed and the goods leave within the stipulated statutory period (generally 90 days). Exported services are outside the territorial scope of ITBMS when supplied to a non-resident recipient and rendered or economically exploited outside Panama; qualifying exporters may credit and recover attributable input ITBMS. For remote desktop/IoT software services, eligibility requires that the beneficiary is located abroad, the contract designates foreign use, and the payment is received from abroad.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Aduanera de Exportación processed through SIGA/SICG)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (master and house) evidencing physical departure of goods
Inward Remittance Certificate (constancia bancaria de ingreso de divisas evidencing the foreign payment)
Commercial invoice and export sales contract or service level agreement
Proof of performance and foreign use/exploitation for exported software or remote support services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI may scrutinize zero-rated export transactions and, upon finding false or insufficient substantiation, retroactively claw back all zero-rated ITBMS credits and exemptions within the 5-year statute of limitations. Law 76 of 2019 (Tax Procedure Code) imposes a 25% surcharge on the evaded ITBMS, monthly interest at the statutory bank lending rate, fines up to PAB 50,000, and suspension of the RUC. Where the conduct constitutes criminal tax fraud, personal liability may arise under Panamanian law with imprisonment from 2 to 5 years. Export documentation must be retained for at least 7 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama does not have a central bank issuing national fiat currency. The de facto banking and financial-system regulator is the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP); the securities market is supervised by the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores (SMV); fiscal administration is vested in the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) through the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI); the Financial Intelligence Unit for AML/CFT is the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF). The U.S. dollar is full legal tender, and the Panamanian Balboa (PAB) circulates solely as fractional coins at a fixed 1:1 parity with the U.S. dollar.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama is fully dollarized and maintains no capital controls, no exchange-permit regime, and no distinction between current-account and capital-account convertibility. Non-resident shareholders may inject equity capital, extend shareholder loans, receive dividends, repay principal and repatriate sale proceeds freely in U.S. dollars without central-bank approval or exchange-form filing. The only practical barriers are bank-level compliance controls (source-of-funds verification, sanctions screening and tax-status validation) and Panama's territorial tax framework: income earned outside Panama is not subject to Panamanian corporate income tax, while dividends distributed by a Panamanian corporation out of Panamanian taxable profits are subject to a 5 percent withholding tax, increasing to 10 percent where the underlying profits have not borne Panamanian income tax. There are no profit-remittance registration or prior-authorization hurdles.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory export-proceeds surrender rules, mandatory repatriation timelines or minimum conversion ratios in Panama. A Panamanian exporter may retain 100 percent of foreign-currency receipts in any onshore or offshore account and may freely dispose of such proceeds for any lawful purpose. For ISIC 6201 software exports, invoices may be denominated in USD, EUR or any agreed currency; proceeds derived from services economically performed outside Panama remain outside DGI territorial tax reach, provided the exporter maintains contemporaneous documentary evidence of the place of performance and the corresponding client location.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Account (Cuenta Operativa) in USD, with availability of EUR and GBP sub-accounts; a segregated Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Capital Suscrito) is recommended for formal paid-in capital injection
USD Operational Account; separate Capital Escrow Account for subscribed capital; multi-currency treasury overlay available
USD Operational Account with multi-currency wallet options; particularly receptive to non-resident software exporters

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Medium, with material legal constraints. Panama does not operate a dedicated Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licence category; any deposit-taking or payment-account activity requires an SBP banking licence or an SBP digital-banking licence under Acuerdo No. 4 de 2019, as subsequently amended, which permits 100 percent digital banks. Offshore EMIs, including Mercury, Airwallex, Wise Business and Relay, generally exclude Panamanian corporate entities because of jurisdictional risk policies and correspondent-clearing restrictions; where accepted, onboarding is typically limited to natural persons domiciled in supported countries. Given the target payment rails (Stripe and Paddle), neither Stripe nor Paddle currently lists Panama as a supported merchant payout jurisdiction. The practical, compliant structure is a U.S. or U.K. intermediate holding vehicle acting as merchant of record for Stripe/Paddle, with the Panamanian Sociedad Anónima owning the software IP and receiving an arm's-length royalty via SWIFT MT103 into a Panamanian bank account. This preserves the Panama treasury hub while satisfying payment-facilitator country availability.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is legally permissible under SBP customer-due-diligence rules only if the bank applies identification measures equivalent to face-to-face verification, such as enhanced video-KYC with biometric checks and independent documentary validation. In practice, Banco General and Banistmo require a physical visit to Panama by at least one director, normally the Presidente and the Secretario/Tesorero (or a single director holding multiple corporate offices where the articles of incorporation permit), for signature authentication, board-resolution acknowledgement and compliance interview. Banistmo and Towerbank offer a hybrid remote route provided the corporate resolution is apostilled at the Registro Público or Panamanian Consulate and the designated signatory completes a live video interview plus a foreign-bank reference check. Banco Nacional de Panamá does not support remote opening for non-resident-owned entities. For the fully remote IOT software business model, Towerbank and Banistmo are the most viable first-choice institutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived Panamanian shell-company or bearer-share risk: SBP Law 23 de 2015 requires identification of all ultimate beneficial owners; bearer shares have been immobilised, and nominee shareholders must be disclosed with a declaration of the real owner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation and good standing from the Registro Público (Certificado de Registro y Paz y Salvo); certified copy of the Share Register (Libro de Registro de Acciones) evidencing fully registered nominative shares and transfer history; DGI-filed ultimate beneficial owner declaration (Declaración de Beneficiario Final); passport copies of every natural-person shareholder holding more than 10 percent; notarised source-of-funds affidavit for the opening deposit; two bank reference letters from the principal foreign bank of each shareholder; opening balance sheet prepared by a Panamanian Contador Público Autorizado (CPA).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue-source opacity and mismatch between the declared remote screen-share and IOT telemetry software activity and expected transaction flows during the first 12 months.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed software licence agreements and SaaS subscription terms with identifiable end clients; anonymised MRR and ARR reports exported from the payment facilitator (Stripe/Paddle) or from the licensed U.S./U.K. merchant-of-record entity; platform user-count and data-processing appendices; domain registration certificate, cloud provider invoices and public website evidencing live operations; reviewed annual financial statements (Estados Financieros) issued by a Panamanian CPA; RUC (Aviso de Operación) reflecting ISIC 6201 classification; a brief business plan and product demonstration video for the compliance file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: OFAC, EU and UN sanctions exposure: Panamanian U.S.-dollar clearing is routed through U.S. correspondent banks, triggering automated SDN-list screening of all account signatories, shareholders and counterparties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Clear nationality and tax-residence evidence of each shareholder and director (passport, utility bill, certificate of tax residence); sworn declaration of non-affiliation with OFAC/EU/UN sanctions lists, confirmed at account opening and on any ownership change; curriculum vitae and professional references for each principal; corporate structure chart traced to ultimate individual owners; written undertaking to notify the bank within 15 days of any legal, shareholding or beneficial-ownership modification.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: shareholder executes a board resolution of the Panamanian S.A. calling in the subscribed capital; remittance is made by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's foreign bank to the Panamanian bank's U.S. dollar correspondent account, with field 70 Remittance Information stating 'Aporte de Capital – Suscripción de Acciones' (capital contribution for share subscription). If the injection is instead a shareholder loan, field 70 must state 'Préstamo de Accionista', and a signed loan agreement with commercial terms plus the source-of-funds file must be retained for SBP and DGI inspection. Verification requirements at the Panamanian bank: updated share subscription schedule, entry in the Share Register, and a written issuer receipt acknowledging the paid-in amount. Single cash deposits of USD 10,000 or more within a 30-day period generate an automatic currency transaction report; cumulative movements exceeding USD 100,000 may trigger an enhanced source-of-wealth questionnaire. The bank will classify the credit as equity or debt based on the documentary bundle, not solely on the SWIFT message.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 wire transfer is the primary rail for all trade settlements, including software subscription fees, intercompany IP royalties, subcontractor payments, cloud infrastructure costs and regulatory fees, using the recipient's full account number, IBAN or account identifier and the receiving bank's SWIFT/BIC. (2) Commercial letters of credit under UCP 600 are available from Banco General and Banistmo but are economically unnecessary for intangible digital services; a commercial LC is used only for the physical hardware component of the IOT telemetry product stream and is issued as an irrevocable sight or usance LC with a U.S. confirming bank. (3) Merchant-of-record payouts from Stripe and Paddle are settled to the U.S. or U.K. intermediate entity and subsequently remitted to the Panamanian S.A. by MT103 as intercompany royalty payments supported by a written IP licensing agreement and a DGI-compliant invoice. Every outbound invoice must carry the corporate RUC and the underlying contract reference; supporting invoices, contracts and bank statements must be retained for at least five years for territorial-tax audit defence.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OTC deliverable FX forwards (USD against EUR, GBP, CAD or CHF) offered by Banco General, Banistmo, Towerbank or a qualified international broker bank, with tenors typically up to 24 months under standard ISDA or bank master agreements
Cross-currency swaps (plain vanilla USD/EUR or USD/GBP) for structural hedging of material multi-currency receivables generated by Paddle or international distributors
FX spot outright conversions for Stripe and Paddle settlement proceeds using the SBP reference rate
European-style FX options on a request basis from Banistmo or international counterparties, subject to a board-approved treasury policy and notional limits

NDFs are not applicable to USD/PAB because there is no local currency float or convertibility restriction; for EUR/USD or GBP/USD exposures, standard deliverable forwards are used in lieu of non-deliverable instruments

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate registration tax on capital (Tasa Única Anual)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing required by March 31 of each calendar year on the basis of the company's paid-in capital as of December 31 of the prior year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers arrears interest and fines under the Código Fiscal; continued non-payment for extended periods may result in registration penalty surcharges and administrative collection proceedings, but does not directly cause administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual report and renewal of Panamanian corporation registration (Reporte de la Sociedad / Información actualizada)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Dirección General del Registro Público
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing due by December 31 of each calendar year reflecting corporate data as of that date; registered agents must submit the annual report online through the Registro Público system.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file by the statutory deadline results in late fees and automatic suspension of the company's right to engage in commercial activities; continued default may lead to the company being placed in a non-compliant status and ultimately subject to strike-off or dissolution proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Tax identification number (RUC) annual update / income tax declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual income tax return (Formulario 110 or applicable form) generally due within three months after the close of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year company, filing is due by March 31 of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or late filing attracts statutory fines, moratory interest at the DGI rate, and potential impediments to obtaining solvency certificates; chronic non-compliance may trigger forced assessment and administrative enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal operation license annual declaration (Aviso de operación renovación)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipality of the registered place of business (e.g., Municipio de Panamá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual renewal due on January 31 of each calendar year, or within the municipal ordinance schedule for the business location.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs municipal fines and surcharges; prolonged delinquency may result in suspension of the municipal operating license and prohibition on carrying out local business activities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual registry of ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Dirección General del Registro Público / designated legal registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: To be confirmed and updated annually as part of the corporate annual report process; changes in shareholding or beneficial ownership must be reported promptly and reviewed as of the December 31 filing date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Incomplete or non-filed UBO information may subject the company and its directors to monetary fines under Panama's beneficial ownership legislation; ongoing non-compliance may block access to commercial registry certificates and filings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Sociedad Anónima must appoint a certified public accountant and, for tax purposes, submit audited financial statements to the DGI when gross annual revenue exceeds USD 1.5 million or when the company's fiscal year-end assets exceed USD 1.5 million (as established by Panamanian tax regulations); smaller companies may submit unaudited financial statements unless the DGI requires an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panamanian General Accounting Regulations (Reglamento de Contabilidad) and IFRS as adopted by the Accounting Profession; IFRS is generally accepted for statutory and tax reporting purposes, with local GAAP permitted where applicable for certain small entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Panamanian law requires the registered agent to keep a confidential registry of ultimate beneficial owners at its offices; any transfer of shares or change in beneficial ownership must be recorded in the share register ledger (Registro de Accionistas) and communicated to the registered agent, with the company's law firm and UBO register updated within a reasonable time not exceeding the annual reporting cycle; the shareholder register must be maintained at the registered agent's office and made available to Panamanian authorities upon lawful request, and companies must update the beneficial ownership information within 15 business days of any change.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – USD 4,000 for a typical certified audit of a small trading or holding company, depending on complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (flat rate on Panamanian-source net taxable income under Article 699 of the Código Fiscal)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial system: genuinely foreign-source software, SaaS subscription, remote screen-share, and IoT telemetry revenue can be outside Panamanian-source and effectively untaxed if economic activity is performed outside Panama. No general statutory tax holiday applies to a standard Sociedad Anónima; special free-zone and SEM regimes exist but require physical/economic substance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 701 (Declaración Anual del Impuesto sobre la Renta – Personas Jurídicas); filed through the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) electronic tax portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due no later than 31 March following the close of the fiscal year for calendar-year taxpayers; where a different fiscal year-end is approved, within three months after that fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registro Único de Contribuyente of the S.A., corporate name, fiscal year, legal representative identification, and tax domicile.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Panamanian legal representative's RUC and the S.A.'s corporate RUC; identify the ultimate foreign beneficial owner in the supplementary shareholder schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A – Ingresos gravables de fuente panameña
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross Panamanian-source revenue from remote screen-share/IoT software sales, licensing, and support services after deducting refunds and discounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exclude foreign-source revenue only when customer contracts, server location, performance logs, and delivery evidence demonstrate that the service is economically rendered outside Panama.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B – Costos y gastos deducibles
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable costs attributable to Panamanian-source income, including personnel, cloud infrastructure, marketing, and intercompany fees that satisfy arm's-length and deduction requirements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not deduct costs allocable to foreign-source income; maintain intercompany agreements, TP documentation, and evidence of actual IT/engineering substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box C – Ajustes fiscales y precios de transferencia
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjustments for transfer pricing, thin capitalisation, tax disallowances, and loss carryforward applications.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For controlled remittances of royalties, support fees, and cost-sharing, disclose the selected OECD methodology and local-file reference.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after statutory deductions and prior-year loss set-offs; maximum carryforward is five years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-owned Panamanian S.A. must not eliminate Panamanian-source profit through passive offshore fees without economic substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity-level income tax at 25% of net taxable Panamanian-source income; includes Panamanian-source capital gains.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No tax is imposed on foreign-source export software revenue of a qualifying territorial S.A.; record the source analysis in the working papers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box F – Créditos, retenciones y pagos adelantados
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for Panamanian withholding taxes, advance payments, and prior-quarter provisional payments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support all credits with bank certificates and official DGI receipts issued in the name of the S.A.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Anexo – Declaración de dividendos y remesas
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of dividends resolved or paid, including gross dividend, applicable 10% withholding tax, and treaty-rate reductions claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a DTA reduction is claimed, attach the foreign shareholder's certificate of tax residence and beneficial-ownership evidence before filing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts DGI administrative fines, a monthly surcharge on the unpaid corporate income tax, and statutory interest; deliberate non-filing or false filing may be prosecuted as tax fraud with financial penalties and imprisonment for the responsible directors.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 730 (Declaración Informativa de Precios de Transferencia); filed through the DGI electronic portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed concurrently with the annual income tax return, generally no later than 31 March following the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Identificación del contribuyente y grupo multinacional
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RUC, corporate name, parent/ultimate parent, tax residence, and global organisational structure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign-parented S.A. must identify the ultimate parent jurisdiction and the direct foreign shareholder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate and itemised related-party transactions: software licences, royalties, support fees, cloud costs, interest, and management charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all cross-border related-party payments in USD/PAB and classify by ISIC 6201 business scope.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Método de precios de transferencia aplicado
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of the most appropriate arm's-length method for each controlled transaction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use CUP for SaaS licences when reliable external comparables exist; use TNMM for remote-support service functions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Comparability factors, adjustments, financial ratios, and source of comparables used to support margins.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Document loss-making or low-margin IoT telemetry distribution; a low-risk captive function must earn a arm's-length return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of employees, offices, contracts in Panama, and locally performed functions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the S.A. is a pure IP-holding or billing conduit without substance, treaty and TP defences will fail.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file or maintenance of deficient TP documentation allows DGI to recharacterise transactions, adjust Panamanian-source income, impose late-filing fines, and assess penalties up to 2% of the controlled transactions, plus interest.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on gross dividends paid or credited out of Panamanian-source profits; the Panamanian S.A. acts as withholding agent.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a reduced DTA dividend rate, the foreign shareholder must obtain a certificate of tax residence from its jurisdiction of residence, deliver it to the Panamanian S.A. before payment, and complete the DGI treaty-relief form; the withholding agent must retain the certificate, beneficial-ownership declaration, and supporting shareholder register entries for at least six years. Treaty rates commonly reduce the 10% domestic dividend tax to 5% or 10% subject to minimum shareholding thresholds.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic withholding on Panamanian-source royalties is generally 10% on gross remittances; DTA rates typically range from 5% to 10%. Panamanian-source interest paid to non-residents is generally subject to a 5% domestic withholding rate; treaty relief may reduce or exempt interest, and portfolio interest paid to foreign banks on external loans is often treated as foreign-source and not taxable in Panama.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: B/. 250,000 (Panamanian Balboa at par with USD) in aggregate related-party transactions triggers mandatory Local File and Form 730 filing obligations; a Master File is required for multinational groups meeting DGI consolidated revenue thresholds.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations apply to relevant activities including IP holding, management, distribution, and service functions. A remote screen-share/IoT S.A. claiming Panama tax residence or DTA benefits must demonstrate locally directed management, adequate staff, office presence, and economic risk in Panama; a bare shell without substance will be disregarded and its income re-sourced or treaty benefits denied.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Fraudulent Corporate Income Tax Return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally omitting Panamanian-source revenue, using fabricated invoices to inflate costs, or fraudulently re-characterising Panamanian-source SaaS/IoT revenue as foreign-source income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of unpaid tax, surcharge and statutory interest; criminal tax penalties of up to B/. 100,000 and imprisonment from two to six years under Panamanian criminal tax provisions; forfeiture of proceeds and account freezes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable for the tax deficiency; criminal conviction triggers travel bans, disqualification from serving as directors, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A Panama S.A. with no physical office, no employees, no local books, and no locally directed management, used only to receive Stripe/Paddle payments or toHold IP royalties and claim treaty benefits without substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI may disregard the entity under anti-abuse doctrine, re-source income to Panama, deny DTA benefits, impose penalties up to 100% of unpaid tax, and request administrative dissolution of the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee and statutory directors remain exposed; beneficial owners may be identified through annual beneficial-ownership filings; travel bans and director disqualification can follow.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file Form 730 or prepare Local File, charging non-arm's-length royalties, allocating group profits to a zero-substance Panamanian IP entity, or engaging in circular cross-border loans with no economic rationale.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI adjustment to taxable income based on the most appropriate method, disallowance of deductibility of controlled payments, penalty up to 2% of controlled transactions, and statutory interest on underpaid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: CFO, tax director, and statutory directors may be personally liable for negligent certification of false TP documentation; professional disqualification and administrative fines apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Dividend Withholding and Profit Repatriation Non-Compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying dividends to a foreign shareholder without applying the 10% statutory withholding tax, or applying a DTA rate without a valid certificate of residence and beneficial-ownership evidence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Panamanian withholding agent becomes personally liable for the unremitted dividend tax, plus surcharge, interest, and a fine equal to the tax not withheld; DGI may freeze bank accounts and issue embargoes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorised an unlawful distribution are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid withholding tax and can be subject to criminal tax prosecution and travel bans.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Sanctions / Illicit Software Payment Flow
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using remote screen-share or IoT telemetry software to facilitate ransomware, remote-access fraud, or payments involving sanctioned persons, while failing to perform basic merchant/KYC checks on resellers and payment aggregators.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Panama AML Law (Ley 23 de 2015), fines of one to five times the laundered amount, asset forfeiture, and imprisonment up to twelve years for money laundering; Stripe/Paddle accounts and corporate bank accounts may be seized.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officer, and ultimate beneficial owners face criminal liability, personal asset forfeiture, travel bans, and extradition exposure in serious cross-border fraud cases.
